name: Pat Buchanan
role: American political commentator, White House aide and three-time presidential candidate
summary: Buchanan is a paleoconservative who argues for sharply cutting immigration, ending birthright citizenship for illegal aliens' children, assimilation, and protective tariffs against free trade. He opposes abortion, same-sex marriage and rulings that remove religion from public life, and wants Congress to rein in judges. He argues the US should withdraw from the UN, bring troops home, review NATO guarantees and avoid empire, calling the Iraq war a neoconservative error.
